channel.title: True EDC
channel.description: Everyday carry, picked by budget. No fluff.

item.title: The Best EDC Gifts of 2026, by Budget
item.description: Ten everyday-carry gifts that actually get used, sorted into under $25, under $50 and splurge. Real products, prices checked Nov 15, 2026. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: EDC Stocking Stuffers Under $25
item.description: Small, useful, under $25: the everyday-carry stocking stuffers people keep using in March. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: A Complete First EDC Kit for Under $100
item.description: Five pieces, one budget: a small tool, a light, a pen, a notebook and a better keyring, all for under $100. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Victorinox Classic SD: Under $25 EDC pick
item.description: The gift nobody returns. It is small enough to forget about until the moment someone needs to open a package, trim a thread or tighten a screw, and then they never forget who gave it to them. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Olight iMini 2: Under $25 EDC pick
item.description: A phone flashlight drains the phone. This rides on the keys and is always there for the parking lot, the dropped earbud under the car seat or the dark porch lock. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Nite Ize S-Biner MicroLock (2-pack): Under $25 EDC pick
item.description: The cheapest upgrade in EDC. It splits car keys from house keys and lets a light or a knife come off the ring in a second. Perfect stocking filler. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Field Notes Original Kraft (3-pack): Under $25 EDC pick
item.description: For the person who still writes things down. It fits in a back pocket and has a cult following, so it reads as a thoughtful gift, not a cheap one. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Casio F-91W: Under $50 EDC pick
item.description: The most famous cheap watch in the world. It is light enough to wear to bed and cheap enough to wear to the gym, which is exactly why people end up wearing it every day. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Fisher Space Pen Bullet (Matte Black): Under $50 EDC pick
item.description: Fisher's pressurized cartridge is made to write upside down and in the cold. Capped, it is about 3.75 inches long; with the cap posted, it is a full-size pen. It looks more expensive than it is. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Gerber Dime: Under $50 EDC pick
item.description: Real pliers on a keychain. It is the tool people reach for at tailgates, campsites and in the junk drawer, and the bottle opener alone earns its spot. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: CIVIVI Elementum: Worth the splurge
item.description: The knife enthusiasts recommend to people buying their first good one. Clean, slim, and it feels far nicer in the hand than its price suggests. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Leatherman Skeletool CX: Worth the splurge
item.description: A full-size Leatherman that disappears in a pocket. If the person on your list already has a cheap multitool, this is the one that replaces it for good. Links may earn us a commission. #ad

item.title: Leatherman Wave+: Worth the splurge
item.description: The multitool that ends up being handed down. It is the classic big gift for a dad, a new homeowner or anyone who fixes things. Eighteen tools, and the ones people use most open from outside without unfolding the handles. Links may earn us a commission. #ad
